- **这周有什么值得改的？**"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"DeepTrace 不是 log viewer，也不是普通 dashboard——它把会话事件日志聚合成报告，让这些问题有答案。"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## The loop"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"TRACE"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Sessions / tokens / cost / tools become queryable evidence."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"→"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"DIAGNOSE"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Deterministic findings locate failures, waste and cost anomalies."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"→"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"IMPROVE"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Recommendations include evidence and a verification plan."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"→"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"APPLY"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Only predefined safe changes can be applied after explicit approval."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"→"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"VERIFY"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Post-change evidence determines VERIFIED / NOT IMPROVED / INCONCLUSIVE."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"一次报告，走完整个闭环。Apply 只接受**用户批准的、allowlisted 的、受控的**修改；Apply 不是 autonomous optimization，self-healing 不在范"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"告，走完整个闭环。Apply 只接受**用户批准的、allowlisted 的、受控的**修改；Apply 不是 autonomous optimization，self-healing 不在范围内。"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## v0.6.1 — Accounting Correctness"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"**Correct history.
